Class IntelHEX

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.io.IntelHEX
@NotThreadSafe public class IntelHEX extends Object
Generator and loader of 16-bit Intel Hex files (I8HEX).

File format is described here: Intel HEX

  • Method Details

    • add

      public int add(String hexData)
      Adds sequential bytes into the code table. The bytes are encoded as hex String, each byte consuming exactly 2 hex digits.

      For example, 0A0B10 represents 3 bytes: 0x0A, 0x0B and 0x10.

      Parameters:
      hexData - Hexadecimal representation of binary code
      Returns:
      next address

    • add

      public int add(byte... data)
      Adds sequential bytes into the code table.

      The bytes are added in the same order as they appear (i.e. they are not converted to different endian).

      Parameters:
      data - sequential bytes to add
      Returns:
      next address

    • add

      public int add(byte data)
      Add code byte into the code table.
      Parameters:
      data - byte to add
      Returns:
      next address

    • add

      public void add(Map<Integer,String> hexCodeMap)
      Adds code (encoded as hex String) into the code table. The code is added in the order from lowest to highest address found in the map.

      Keys of the map represent addresses and values represent code.

      Parameters:
      hexCodeMap - sub-table with addresses and codes

    • getCode
